resources.string: Optional Tilecast Control Assist observes only the foreground application name, can return to Tilecast after an approved delay, and can request Android lock for Power Assist. It never reads page text, passwords, clicks buttons, performs gestures, or approves installations.
Tilecast Managed Kiosk keeps the player pinned on screen, makes it the Home app, and relaunches it automatically. It is active only after deliberate device-owner provisioning.
